attributes.searchDescription: Parking lots within, near, or for use at City of Anacortes parks.

values.value: $13 per day with a 14 day maximum
Overnight parking is allowed with a payment of $6.00 per night, paid in advance. Those  parked after closing without payment will be ticketed and or towed away at owner’s  expense.
Parking is limited to a maximum of one hour. Vehicles over time limit and after closing  will be ticketed and/or towed away at owner’s expense. Maximum vehicle length is 20  feet.
Parking is limited to day use. Vehicles left after closing will be ticketed and or towed at  owner’s expense. No boat trailers either single or in combination with a vehicle.
